cases.proves: Done When 2: An Obsidian source relation survives push to the database source value and pull into a Roam referenced node.
cases.checks: Both nodes import with no failure and no warning, the Source page is `@PK 2143 Obsidian source`, and the Evidence page is titled with a reference to it: `[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with source - [[@PK 2143 Obsidian source]]`.

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.waitFor(() => proof.page.exists("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with source - [[@PK 2143 Obsidian source]]") && proof.page.exists("@PK 2143 Obsidian source"), { what: 'the imported Evidence page naming its Source, and the Source page', timeout: 30000 }); const callout = proof.byText('.bp3-dialog .bp3-callout', 'imported'); proof.assert(callout, 'No import result on screen.'); const result = callout.innerText; proof.assert(/2 imported, 0 skipped, 0 failed/.test(result) && !/warning/i.test(result), 'The import result reads ' + JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 200)) + '.'); })()

cases.title: An unavailable source never fails the import
cases.proves: Done When 5: A missing or unavailable Source node remains non-blocking, emits the expected warning, and creates no placeholder.
cases.checks: The import result has no failed node; the placeholder-titled page exists once; no page was made for the unavailable Source or for a placeholder Source.
cases.caption: The unavailable source was a warning, not a failure: the node came in, nothing was left half-imported, and no placeholder Source page exists.

expect.js: (() => { const callout = proof.byText('.bp3-dialog .bp3-callout', 'imported'); proof.assert(callout, 'No import result on screen.'); const result = callout.innerText; proof.assert(/ 0 failed/.test(result), 'A node failed: ' + JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 200))); const pages = window.roamAlphaAPI.q('[:find [?t ...] :where [?p :node/title ?t] [(clojure.string/includes? ?t "PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with hidden source")]]'); proof.assert(pages.length === 1 && pages[0] === "[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with hidden source - [[@placeholder]]", 'The pages for the evidence are ' + JSON.stringify(pages) + '.'); proof.assert(!proof.page.exists("@PK 2143 Obsidian hidden source"), 'A page was made for the unavailable Source.'); })()

steps.why: open the Evidence page whose Source was imported and filled in

do.js: proof.waitFor(() => { const t = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bp3-toast')).find((e) => /Refreshed/.test(e.innerText)); if (!t) return false; window.__pk2143Green = { warning: t.classList.contains('bp3-intent-warning'), success: t.classList.contains('bp3-intent-success'), text: t.innerText }; return true; }, { what: 'the toast', timeout: 60000 })

expect.js: (() => { const w = window.__pk2143Warn; const g = window.__pk2143Green; proof.assert(w && w.warning, 'The refresh of the placeholder page did not show a warning toast: ' + JSON.stringify(w)); proof.assert(w.text.includes('No source was published with this node.'), 'The warning toast does not say why: ' + w.text); proof.assert(g && g.success && !g.warning, 'The refresh after the Source arrived was not a success toast: ' + JSON.stringify(g)); proof.assert(!g.text.includes('No source was published'), 'The success toast still carries a source warning: ' + g.text); })()

cases.checks: Refreshing the placeholder page shows an orange toast with the refresh message and the source warning; refreshing the page whose Source has arrived shows a green toast with no warning.

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.waitFor(() => proof.page.exists("EVD - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with colliding title"), { what: 'the imported page under the incoming title', timeout: 30000 }); const callout = proof.byText('.bp3-dialog .bp3-callout', 'imported'); proof.assert(callout, 'No import result on screen.'); const result = callout.innerText; proof.assert(/1 imported, 0 skipped, 0 failed, 1 with warnings/.test(result), 'The import result reads ' + JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 200)) + '.'); const text = result.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); proof.assert(text.includes('already belongs to another page') && text.includes('kept the incoming title'), 'No collision warning: ' + JSON.stringify(text.slice(0, 400))); proof.assert(proof.page.exists("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with colliding title - [[@placeholder]]"), 'The user\'s page is gone.'); const kept = window.roamAlphaAPI.pull('[:block/props]', [':block/uid', proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Obsidian evidence with colliding title - [[@placeholder]]")]); proof.assert(!JSON.stringify(kept).includes('importedFrom'), 'The user\'s page was overwritten by the import.'); })()

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => { const source = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Linked evidence - [[@placeholder]]"); const destination = proof.uid("[[CLM]] - PK 2143 Linked claim"); if (!source || !destination) return false; const found = proof.relations.touching([source]).filter((item) => item.sourceUid === source && item.destinationUid === destination); const supports = proof.relations.schemaId('Supports'); return found.length === 1 && found[0].tentative === 'true' && found[0].hasSchema === supports && !/multiple matches|relations were not/i.test(proof.toastText()); }, { what: 'one pending Supports relation from the linked evidence to the linked claim, with no error', timeout: 30000 })

cases.title: Sharing a Source, then the Evidence that cites it, stores the source value
cases.proves: Done When 1: A Roam referenced node survives push to the database source value and pull into an Obsidian relation.
cases.checks: The published Evidence concept's sourceDocument is the published Source concept, and its core title is just the content.
cases.caption: Share the Roam Source, then the Evidence page that names it. The database now holds the Evidence with a sourceDocument pointing at the Source.

expect.js: (async () => { const srcUid = proof.uid("@PK 2143 Roam source"); const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam evidence - [[@PK 2143 Roam source]]"); proof.assert(srcUid && uid, 'A page is missing.'); const src = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(srcUid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=literal_content,reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); proof.assert(row.reference_content && row.reference_content.sourceDocument === src.id, 'The sourceDocument is ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content) + ', not the Source concept ' + src.id + '.'); proof.assert(row.literal_content.core_title === 'PK 2143 Roam evidence', 'The core title is ' + JSON.stringify(row.literal_content.core_title) + '.'); })()

cases.title: Sharing the Evidence again keeps one node and the same source value
cases.proves: Done When 7: Repeated push and pull operations create no duplicate nodes or relations and do not churn unchanged titles.
cases.checks: Exactly the two published concepts exist for the Source and Evidence pages, the Evidence still points at the Source, and its stored title is unchanged.
cases.caption: Share the evidence a second time. Still one Evidence node and one Source node in the database, with the same source value and title.

expect.js: (async () => { const srcUid = proof.uid("@PK 2143 Roam source"); const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam evidence - [[@PK 2143 Roam source]]"); const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const rows = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id,source_local_id,reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=in.(' + srcUid + ',' + uid + ')', { key }); proof.assert(rows.length === 2, 'Expected two concepts, found ' + rows.length + '.'); const src = rows.find((r) => r.source_local_id === srcUid); const evd = rows.find((r) => r.source_local_id === uid); proof.assert(evd.reference_content && evd.reference_content.sourceDocument === src.id, 'The sourceDocument changed to ' + JSON.stringify(evd.reference_content) + '.'); const direct = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Content?select=text&space_id=eq.120237&variant=eq.direct&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key }); proof.assert(direct.length === 1 && direct[0].text.includes('PK 2143 Roam evidence'), 'The stored title is ' + JSON.stringify(direct) + '.'); })()

expect.js: (async () => { const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam bare evidence - [[@placeholder]]"); proof.assert(uid, 'The page is missing.'); const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); proof.assert(!row.reference_content || row.reference_content.sourceDocument === undefined, 'A source value was stored: ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content) + '.'); const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const named = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&space_id=eq.120237&name=eq.' + encodeURIComponent('@placeholder'), { key }); proof.assert(named.length === 0, 'A concept named @placeholder was published.'); const pageUid = proof.uid('@placeholder'); if (pageUid) { const byUid = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(pageUid), { key }); proof.assert(byUid.length === 0, 'The @placeholder page was published as a node.'); } proof.assert(!/not in this space yet/.test(proof.toastText()), 'The publish warned about a missing source: ' + proof.toastText()); })()

expect.js: (async () => { proof.assert(/not in this space yet/.test(proof.toastText()) && proof.toastText().includes('PK 2143 Roam unpublished source'), 'No warning about the unpublished source: ' + JSON.stringify(proof.toastText())); const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam orphan evidence - [[@PK 2143 Roam unpublished source]]"); const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); proof.assert(!row.reference_content || row.reference_content.sourceDocument === undefined, 'A source value was stored: ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content) + '.'); const srcUid = proof.uid("@PK 2143 Roam unpublished source"); const found = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(srcUid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }); proof.assert(found.length === 0, 'The unpublished Source reached the database.'); })()

expect.js: (async () => { const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const srcUid = proof.uid("@PK 2143 Roam ordered source"); const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam ordered evidence - [[@PK 2143 Roam ordered source]]"); proof.assert(srcUid && uid, 'A page is missing.'); const src = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(srcUid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); proof.assert(row.reference_content && row.reference_content.sourceDocument === src.id, 'The sourceDocument is ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content) + ', not the Source concept ' + src.id + '.'); proof.assert(!/not in this space yet/.test(proof.toastText()), 'The last publish still warned about a missing source: ' + proof.toastText()); })()

expect.js: (async () => { const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const uid = proof.uid("[[EVD]] - PK 2143 Roam evidence of imported source - [[@PK 2143 Obsidian source]]"); proof.assert(uid, 'The page is missing.'); const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=reference_content&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(uid), { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published concept', timeout: 20000, interval: 500 })); const origin = (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.106039&source_local_id=eq.pk-2143-o2r-src', { key }))[0]; proof.assert(origin, 'The vault Source concept is missing.'); proof.assert(row.reference_content && row.reference_content.sourceDocument === origin.id, 'The sourceDocument is ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content) + ', not the Source\'s origin concept ' + origin.id + '.'); const importedUid = proof.uid("@PK 2143 Obsidian source"); if (importedUid) { const local = await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(importedUid), { key }); proof.assert(local.length === 0, 'The imported Source page was published as a node of its own.'); } proof.assert(!/not in this space yet/.test(proof.toastText()), 'A missing-source warning was shown: ' + proof.toastText()); })()

title: Round-trip Roam and Obsidian source references
claim: In Roam, an Evidence node's source survives the round trip: what the Obsidian vault shares comes in as a referenced Source, a missing or unavailable source warns without blocking and shows [[@placeholder]], refreshing and importing again change nothing, and what Roam shares keeps its source value.
given: test-3-graph is signed in to the proof database, in the eng-2329-demo group with the Obsidian test vault. The vault published two Evidence notes with a Source each (one Source is hidden from the group) and one Evidence note with none. Stored Relations is on, and Roam has a Source page, the Evidence page that cites it, an Evidence page whose source is [[@placeholder]], and an Evidence page citing a Source that is never shared. Nothing from the vault was imported yet. The Obsidian half is in the eng-2143-obsidian kit.
